checklist.item: A perimeter fire containment system fills the gap between slab edge and curtain wall, with a tested system referenced and the same rating as the floor.
checklist.why: The slab-edge gap is a floor-to-floor fire path.

checklist.item: A smoke seal is shown on top of the perimeter fire barrier.
Anchors to the slab allow for building movement and tolerance, with embeds referenced to structural.
checklist.why: Curtain wall anchors need three-way adjustment.

checklist.item: Spandrel insulation, back pan and vapor control are shown, with the insulation mechanically held.
checklist.why: Spandrel cavities condense and the insulation falls.

checklist.item: Stack joint location, and the path of drained water to the outside at each floor, are shown.
checklist.why: Water must leave at each stack joint.

checklist.item: Interior finish closure (sill trim, ceiling pocket) is coordinated and tagged.
checklist.why: The closure is usually left undrawn.
